covers.name: One small step
covers.idea: A bold, geometric staircase of tiny daily marks climbs toward a warm horizon, turning repetition into quiet momentum.

covers.name: The patient path
covers.idea: A solitary trail of warm stepping stones crosses a deep, open night toward first light; the rhythm matters more than the distance.

covers.name: A quiet turning
covers.idea: A close-up of a small copper wheel, its steady rotation coaxed by one bead of water and an emerging leaf: tiny effort made regenerative.
